title: Sam Darnold’s return to Levi’s Stadium was written like a Hollywood movie

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sam Darnold’s return to Levi’s Stadium was written like a Hollywood movie
sources.description: When Seattle Seahawks QB Sam Darnold beat the New England Patriots by a Super Bowl score of 29–13, it was a full circle moment for him at Santa Clara's Levi's Stadium.
